title: Alloys: Better Metals by Mixing
summary: Steel, stainless steel, brass, bronze, solder and 22-carat gold: why mixing metals makes them more useful.

cbse.chapter: Ch 3: Metals and Non-metals (corrosion prevention and alloys)

objectives: I can define an alloy and explain that it is a mixture.
I can explain why alloys are often harder than pure metals, using particles.
I can name common alloys, their components and uses.
I can calculate the carat value of gold.
misconceptions: An alloy is a compound (it is a mixture).
Pure metals are always better than alloys.
